summary: Brown voted for the April 2024 supplemental military aid to Israel and against all three November 2024 resolutions (S.J.Res. 111, 113, 115) that would have blocked arms transfers. His spokesperson affirmed his commitment to funding Israel's war, citing Israel's "right to defend itself," and in October 2023 he pledged to support Israel and defeat Hamas. The AJP Action scorecard records him as non-signatory on all three major ceasefire and humanitarian letters, with a 2% overall score.
